n: John Whitmer is asked to write a regular history of the Church and help Joseph Smith copy the revelations. John had been helping as a scribe; history-keeping was now formally his assignment.

f.g: John Whitmer, an older brother of David Whitmer and one of the Eight Witnesses of the Book of Mormon.

n: John may also speak in Church meetings when appropriate. His calling is not only to record but to teach.
He is appointed to keep the Church’s records and history continually, because Oliver Cowdery, the first recorder, has been called to other work.

f.w: Oliver Cowdery I have appointed to another office
f.g: Oliver had gone on a mission to the Lamanites on Missouri’s western frontier.

n: John was reluctant to accept, but the Lord promises that if he is faithful, the Comforter will help him write. Inspired help comes even for record-keeping.
